links.comparator_used: Aggregate performance across all patients (overall sensitivity 64.1%, specificity 98.8%)
links.outcome: Detection of subgroup and site-level performance variation hidden by aggregate metrics
links.effect: Sensitivity by PE location: central 88.6%, lobar or segmental 63.1%, subsegmental 33.3%. By chronicity: acute 65.5%, chronic 57.4%. By site: 68.7% vs 55.7% (P < .001), against 64.1% overall.
links.quote: Sensitivity differed significantly between the two highest-volume sites, 68.7% and 55.7% (P < .001), with CT scanner as the only variable different between the two sites.

links.outcome: Agreement of automated LLM-extracted reference-standard labels with radiologist annotation
links.quote: Reference-standard PE characteristic labels were extracted from radiology reports using a zero-shot LLM pipeline validated against a radiologist-annotated 600 reports (κ =0.98).
